verdicts.evidence: lines 428, 453, 525, 547, 552, 614, 665, 668, 733, 737: Try again, Save name, role select, Remove, retry links, Send invite, dialog buttons and switches all have handlers that call the api and re-render
lines 411, 423, 560, 569, 699: name, members, seat count and notification states all come from api.getTeam; empty list shows a no-one-yet message (290-293); no sample or leftover text
lines 656-657: the remove confirmation names the person, their email, the team and the consequence, so the step shows what it depends on
lines 251-287: forms are one field (name) and two fields (email, role); no multi-step task and no free text longer than a line
lines 280, 633: invite role preselected to Member, the lower privilege; line 662: dialog focus starts on 'Keep on team' so Enter does not remove
brief lists six occasional tasks of equal standing; the screen has no single dominant frequent task

lines 248-300: three sections (Team name, People with invite, Email notifications) each map to brief tasks; seat count (569) bears on inviting; last-active text (539) is an extra field in the member row, not a section or control
lines 244, 257, 284: one .primary button in each of the load-failure card, Team name card and invite form; row Remove is quiet (543); dialog has one filled button (310-311)

lines 101, 310-311: in the remove dialog 'Remove from team' is the only filled button (solid red .danger) while 'Keep on team' is plain outlined, so the destructive action has the dominant styling; focus on Cancel (662) does not change that

lines 257, 447-448: 'Save name' is disabled whenever the name is unchanged, with no text saying why (nameMsg is empty). Seats-full disable does have a reason (610); row disables are own-request (524, 546)
line 539: the only tooltip is a title on the time element giving the full date; the visible text already states activity, so nothing depends on it
lines 229-313 and all strings in 389-745: no visible text mentions implementation, mock data, the request or unfinished features
lines 250, 268, 298, 657: each note sits at its decision (what name to use, which role to give, no save step for switches, consequence of removal); the seats-full note is at the invite form (610)

lines 297-298: heading 'Email notifications' followed by 'Choose which emails the team gets.' restates it; lines 636-637: invite success is said twice, inline and in a toast
